review_text: After not playing the game for months I log back in and claim my outpost rewards but a bug happens that caused it to overlevel. The rewards were reset and my outpost level set back to its proper level but all of a sudden i owe them 3000 gems of my own earned currency for an issue that I had nothing to do with. Customer support tries to justify this to me but that is unreasonable because it is not my fault. Not a good look.

At first, this game was great. Good graphics, fast paced runs, lots of champions etc. It was good enough I was willing to give Plarium money. Over the last couple weeks since their Battle Pass, the game has been nothing short of a mess. Constant crashes, won't work half the time on desktop, and the game not even letting you log in, but they say "sorry" with a few gems or a shard. Unless big changes come soon, I think my time will be better spent elsewhere on a fully functioning game.
